description: Every morning, checks open referral cases (Medicare, DVA, or any case marked as a referral) in Cliniko for patients with a booking in the next 28 days. Counts sessions used and already booked against the referral's maximum, and flags a referral that expires within 21 days (or before the next booking), has 1 or fewer sessions left, or would leave bookings unfunded. For each one, AI drafts a request for a new referral to the patient and, if the case has a GP contact with an email, to the GP, and one WorkQ item is created with an approval form. It never contacts anyone itself. It also saves today's list of at-risk referrals for the morning brief.

import json
import datetime

def zulu(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

def write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True), scope="org")

slug = str(params["slug"] or "")
settings = params["settings"] or {}
r = params["referral"] or {}
policy = settings.get("policy") or {}
tone = str(policy.get("tone") or "warm, concise, no jargon")
practice_name = str(settings.get("name") or "")
tz_name = str(settings.get("timezone") or "UTC")
now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

patient_name = str(r.get("patient_name") or "")
first_name = str(r.get("patient_first_name") or "") or patient_name.split(" ")[0]
patient_email = str(r.get("patient_email") or "")
gp_name = str(r.get("gp_name") or "")
gp_email = str(r.get("gp_email") or "")
rtype = str(r.get("referral_type") or "Medicare")
reasons = [str(x) for x in (r.get("reasons") or [])]
title = ("Referral running out: " + patient_name + " (" + rtype + ")")[:200]

# Skip if this patient's referral already has an open item (overlapping runs).
already_open = False
try:
    for row in api.workq.list(search=title) or []:
        if (row.get("title") == title and row.get("status") not in ("done", "cancelled")
                and "referral-watchdog" in (row.get("labels") or [])):
            already_open = True
            break
except Exception:
    already_open = False

todo_id = ""
if not already_open:
    facts = (
        "Patient: " + patient_name + "\n"
        + "Referral: " + rtype + (" (" + str(r.get("case_name") or "") + ")" if r.get("case_name") else "") + "\n"
        + ("Issued: " + str(r.get("issue_label") or "") + "\n" if r.get("issue_label") else "")
        + ("Expires: " + str(r.get("expiry_label") or "") + "\n" if r.get("expiry_label") else "")
        + ("Sessions: " + str(r.get("used")) + " used, " + str(r.get("booked")) + " booked, of " + str(r.get("max_sessions")) + "\n"
           if r.get("max_sessions") else "")
        + "Next booking: " + str(r.get("next_booking_label") or "") + "\n"
        + "Why it's flagged: " + "; ".join(reasons)
    )

    def fallback_patient():
        return ("Hi " + (first_name or "there") + ",\n\nYour " + rtype + " referral for your sessions with us is "
                + ("nearly used up" if any("left" in x for x in reasons) else "due to expire soon")
                + ". To keep your upcoming appointments covered, please book in with your GP for a new referral and "
                + "send it through to us (or ask your GP to send it directly).\n\nThank you,\n" + (practice_name or "The team"))

    def fallback_gp():
        return ("Dear " + (gp_name or "Doctor") + ",\n\nWe are currently seeing your patient " + patient_name + " under a "
                + rtype + " referral that is " + ("nearly used up" if any("left" in x for x in reasons) else "due to expire soon")
                + ". If you consider ongoing care appropriate, could you please issue a new referral and send it through to us?\n\n"
                + "Kind regards,\n" + (practice_name or "The team"))

    drafts = {"patient": "", "gp": ""}
    ai_problem = ""
    try:
        raw = str(api.ai.generate(prompt=(
            "An allied-health practice" + (" called \"" + practice_name + "\"" if practice_name else "")
            + " needs a new referral for a patient whose current one is running out:\n" + facts + "\n\n"
            "Draft two short plain-text emails in a " + tone + " tone:\n"
            "1. \"patient\": to the patient (first name " + (first_name or "unknown") + "), asking them to see their GP for a new "
            + rtype + " referral and send it to the practice, so their upcoming sessions stay covered.\n"
            "2. \"gp\": to the patient's GP" + (" (" + gp_name + ")" if gp_name else "") + ", politely asking whether they would "
            "issue a new referral if they consider ongoing care appropriate.\n"
            "Use real line breaks: greeting, blank line, body, blank line, sign-off" + (" with the practice name" if practice_name else "")
            + ". The ONLY reason to give is: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ". Don't say the referral is expiring unless that "
            "reason mentions expiry, and don't say any booking falls after the expiry date unless it says so. Refer to "
            "the patient by name, never as he or she. Never give clinical advice, never state Medicare or DVA rules or "
            "fees, and never invent details.\n\n"
            'Reply with ONLY JSON, no markdown: {"patient": "<email body>", "gp": "<email body>"}'
        )) or "")
        cleaned = raw.strip().strip("`").strip()
        if cleaned.lower().startswith("json"):
            cleaned = cleaned[4:]
        parsed = json.loads(cleaned.strip()) or {}
        drafts["patient"] = str(parsed.get("patient") or "").strip()
        drafts["gp"] = str(parsed.get("gp") or "").strip()
    except Exception as exc:
        ai_problem = str(exc)
    drafts["patient"] = drafts["patient"] or fallback_patient()
    drafts["gp"] = drafts["gp"] or fallback_gp()

    def quoted(text):
        return "\n".join("> " + ln for ln in text.split("\n"))

    description = (
        "**Patient:** " + patient_name + (" (" + patient_email + ")" if patient_email else " (no email on file)") + "\n\n"
        + "**Referral:** " + rtype + (" · " + str(r.get("case_name") or "") if r.get("case_name") else "")
        + (" · issued " + str(r.get("issue_label") or "") if r.get("issue_label") else "")
        + (" · expires " + str(r.get("expiry_label") or "") if r.get("expiry_label") else "") + "\n\n"
        + ("**Sessions:** " + str(r.get("used")) + " used, " + str(r.get("booked")) + " booked, of " + str(r.get("max_sessions")) + "\n\n"
           if r.get("max_sessions") else "")
        + "**Next booking:** " + str(r.get("next_booking_label") or "") + "\n\n"
        + "**Why it's flagged:** " + "; ".join(reasons) + "\n\n"
        + "**GP:** " + ((gp_name or "Linked contact") + (" (" + gp_email + ")" if gp_email else " (no email on file)") if (gp_name or gp_email) else "no referring contact linked to this case") + "\n\n"
        + "**Draft to the patient:**\n\n" + quoted(drafts["patient"]) + "\n\n"
        + ("**Draft to the GP:**\n\n" + quoted(drafts["gp"]) + "\n\n" if gp_email else "")
        + ("_AI drafting failed (" + ai_problem[:200] + "); showing a standard message._\n\n" if ai_problem else "")
        + "Nothing has been sent yet. Use the form to send the request to the patient or the GP, or close this item if it's handled."
    )

    # Same single-practice test assignee as the other Cliniko automations.
    PRACTITIONER_EMAIL = "sean.baker@mysmb.com"
    assignee_ids: list[str] = []
    try:
        for user in api.users.list() or []:
            if str(user.get("email") or "").strip().lower() == PRACTITIONER_EMAIL:
                if user.get("id"):
                    assignee_ids = [str(user.get("id"))]
                break
    except Exception:
        assignee_ids = []

    days_left = r.get("days_left")
    remaining = r.get("remaining")
    urgent = ((isinstance(days_left, int) and days_left <= 7) or (isinstance(remaining, int) and remaining <= 0)
              or bool(r.get("bookings_after_expiry")))
    item = api.workq.create(
        title=title,
        scope="org",
        description=description,
        priority="high" if urgent else "medium",
        labels=["cliniko-automations", "referral-watchdog"],
        assignee_ids=assignee_ids or None,
    )
    todo_id = str(item["id"])
    if patient_email or gp_email:
        api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=todo_id, form_id=params["request_form"])

    # Everything "Send approved referral request" needs. Flat filename for
    # Knowledge's 2-level folder limit.
    write_json("PracticeManager/State/" + slug + "-referral-req-" + todo_id + ".json", {
        "referral": r, "drafts": drafts, "patient_email": patient_email, "gp_email": gp_email,
        "gp_name": gp_name, "patient_name": patient_name, "created_at": zulu(now),
    })

    # Audit trail (healthcare-practice-management-guardrail-audit format).
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
        today_str = now.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name)).date().isoformat()
    except Exception:
        today_str = now.date().isoformat()
    audit_path = "PracticeManager/AuditLog/" + slug + "-" + today_str + ".jsonl"
    try:
        existing_log = api.files.read(file=audit_path, scope="org")
    except Exception:
        existing_log = ""
    try:
        api.files.put(file=audit_path, scope="org", content=existing_log + json.dumps({
            "ts": zulu(now), "practice_slug": slug, "actor": "agent",
            "source": "automation:Cliniko Automations: Find referrals running out",
            "action": "drafted", "target": {"kind": "patient_case", "id": str(r.get("case_id") or "")},
            "summary": rtype + " referral for " + patient_name + " running out: " + "; ".join(reasons),
            "guardrails": [{"rule": "patient_facing_requires_approval", "result": "pass", "detail": "request drafted only; routed to WorkQ for approval"}],
            "workq_item_id": todo_id,
        }, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass

# Mark this referral handled only once its item exists (or one was already open).
if todo_id or already_open:
    state_path = "PracticeManager/State/" + slug + "-referral-watchdog.json"
    try:
        current_state = json.loads(api.files.read(file=state_path, scope="org") or "{}") or {}
    except Exception:
        current_state = {}
    keys = [str(k) for k in (current_state.get("handled_keys") or []) if k]
    key = str(r.get("key") or "")
    if key and key not in keys:
        keys.append(key)
    api.files.put(file=state_path, content=json.dumps({"handled_keys": keys[-1000:]}, indent=2), scope="org")
